data.hypothesis: Applying T3's smaller block configuration to T4's reciprocal-square-root interaction may raise the number of CTAs and improve device utilization. Half-warp blocks may instead waste execution capacity; the combined program needs measurement.
data.notes: T4 is the better measured starting kernel: valid and correct at a reported mean of 0.0009816780 s, versus T3's valid, correct launch-only result of 0.0017977762 s. This proposal keeps T4's complete kernel and applies T3's block=16/items_per_block=16 configuration. The combined result is unmeasured; these search means are not independent confirmation.
transformations: Retained T4's one-thread-per-target source traversal, Newton-refined rsqrtf inverse-distance calculation, self-pair exclusion, velocity-then-position updates, and exact mass copy.
Applied T3's launch-only change: block=16 and items_per_block=16, with shared_memory_bytes=0; the source index mapping remains consistent with the launch grid.
